title: Typed environment and request boundary
intent: After the backend deployment foundation is accepted on dev, make frontend API, WebSocket and file endpoints configurable while preserving Practicum compatibility.

requirements.title: Environment and transport abstraction
requirements.description: Expose validated mode-specific HTTP, WebSocket and file endpoint configuration; forward explicit CSRF inputs for state-changing requests and remove hardcoded public URLs from templates.

constraints: No secret is committed or emitted in evidence.
Course CI, sprint_* branches and deploy files remain out of scope.
The backend package owns the service implementation; this package consumes its accepted endpoint contract.
